name: Kyo
evidence_note: ABA therapy for autistic children. Kyo's FAQ says the formal diagnosis comes from the child's physician; its services list no diagnostic evaluations.

name: LifeWorks AZ
evidence_note: ADD and ADHD therapy for children, teens and young adults in Phoenix and Scottsdale, including executive-functioning therapy. Therapy only; its site lists no ADHD testing or diagnostic evaluations.

name: Team PBS
evidence_note: In-home and community ABA (Positive Behavior Supports Corporation). The page names the city among those served; its services list no diagnostic evaluations.
